context: Sortable table of sparklines showing monthly D3 skill line-count evolution over 12 months with category color encoding and interactive tooltips.
first_impression: A well-structured sparkline table using a shared global Y-scale for cross-row comparability and correct data-join key functions for sort stability.
what_works: Global Y-scale via d3.extent(data.flatMap(d => d.series)) makes all sparklines directly comparable; key function d => d.skill in .data(sortedData(), d => d.skill) correctly preserves object constancy on sort.
what_doesnt: Area fill uses y0=sparkH (SVG bottom) which maps to the global minimum value, not zero — a truncated baseline for area encoding; the update branch in the data join is a no-op (update => update), so underlying data mutations would not re-render existing rows.
